scope: Explicit test-source execution using the locally extended compiled SafeJS public core and our own document model. Public sites are read-only HTTP loads; injected probe scripts modify only local trees. No website-authored scripts, browser engine, event listeners or automatic page-script execution are enabled. No raw responses or credentials are retained.
